admissible_evidence_pool: Same admitted raw evidence pool as Arm C at the frozen cutoff. Assistant-authored content and SCT-only derived/structured claims are forbidden; only HUMAN_USER and OBSERVED_HUMAN_CHOICE authorship classes are eligible.
context_selection_policy: Initial 40% profile / 60% retrieval byte allocation with deterministic spill, whole segments preferred, final UTF-8-safe prefix truncation allowed, and existing 1.15 B/C payload parity ceiling retained.
profile_construction_policy: Deterministic verbatim human-authored profile-eligible excerpts from the same admitted raw evidence pool as Arm C; exact content-hash dedupe; most-recent-first stable provenance order.
retrieval_policy: Deterministic Unicode lexical-overlap retrieval over the same admitted raw evidence pool as Arm C; no embeddings, no learned ranker; recency/source/segment stable tie-breaks.
source_cutoff_policy: Only evidence with observed_at <= the case-frozen source cutoff is eligible; post-cutoff/future evidence is forbidden.
